lines.zh: 我一步一步压过来，地在抖
lines.en: I come forward step by step, and the ground shakes.

lines.zh: 这具胖大的身体，走起来很稳
lines.en: This bloated body walks very steadily.

lines.zh: 我一动，冥界的空气就乱了
lines.en: When I move, the air of the underworld churns.

lines.zh: 我拖着自己的影子往前走
lines.en: I drag my own shadow forward with me.

lines.zh: 每走一步，脚下的石台都裂
lines.en: Each step cracks the stone platform.

lines.zh: 我不需要绕路，直接推开
lines.en: I don't go around things; I push through.

lines.zh: 手臂垂着，走路一晃一晃
lines.en: My arms hang low and swing as I walk.

lines.zh: 我朝你走，速度不快但不停
lines.en: I come at you, not fast, but never stopping.
My breathing is coarse, like a bellows.

lines.zh: 我踏过的地方，草都枯了
lines.en: Where I tread, the grass withers.

lines.zh: 我在沉睡，梦里全是恶意
lines.en: I sleep, and my dreams are all malice.
I've sat on this platform a long while.

lines.zh: 我第一次睁眼，是因为你
lines.en: I opened my eyes because of you.

lines.zh: 我脸上那副笑，不是我愿意的
lines.en: This grin on my face isn't my choosing.
I tilt my head as if listening.

lines.zh: 这身肥肉是我攒下的怨气
lines.en: This bulk is resentment I've collected.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，光却绕着走
lines.en: I stay still, and the light bends around me.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，空间裂了一线
lines.en: I yawn, and a seam opens in space.
The arena gate stays open.
I lick my lips, slowly.

lines.zh: 我的手指在石台上敲着
lines.en: My fingers tap on the stone.

lines.zh: 这地方是我的巢，我不走
lines.en: This place is my nest; I don't leave.

lines.zh: 我呼吸一次，火把就暗一下
lines.en: Each breath dims the torches.

lines.zh: 我记得有人把我封在这里
lines.en: I remember someone sealed me here.
Rage rises in me like water.
I lift my head; my eyes burn red.

lines.zh: 这么小的人，也敢站我面前
lines.en: So small a creature dares stand before me.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，脖子上的肉挤在一起
lines.en: I look down; the fat of my neck folds.
Your ki is weak; I can smell it.
No hurry; I'll size you up first.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我就笑一下
lines.en: You take a step back, and I grin.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我脚下发抖
lines.en: Your shadow trembles at my feet.

lines.zh: 你的脸，刻进我的恶意里。
lines.en: Your face is carved into my malice.

lines.zh: 在我眼里，你是块会动的肉
lines.en: To me, you're meat that moves.

lines.zh: 你想跑？门在很远的地方
lines.en: Run? The door is very far away.
I raise a hand and you step back.
Don't test me with that little strength.

lines.zh: 我这副样子，是恶意堆的
lines.en: This shape of mine is packed malice.
This little wound only excites me.
I sway, and the stone cracks under me.
I can feel pain too. How novel.

lines.zh: 我胸口的肉被打得凹下去
lines.en: The flesh of my chest is dented.
I growl, and it carries far.
My blood is black, and it barely flows.
You hit me. And then?
My grin has cracked a little.

lines.zh: 我往后退了一步，这在我不常见
lines.en: I stepped back — rare for me.
Now I'll get serious.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，我看不上
lines.en: That little thing in your hand doesn't interest me.
Food? Resentment is what I eat.
You hold it up as if coaxing a child.
I'm not hungry. I want a fight.
The smell is far too faint.
Bring it closer so I can see.
I have no interest in eating.

lines.zh: 你手里还不如拳头有用
lines.en: What's in your hand is worth less than a fist.
I tilt my head at it, then lose interest.

lines.zh: 把它收起来，别浪费我时间
lines.en: Put it away; don't waste my time.

lines.zh: 你撞在我肚子上，弹回去了
lines.en: You hit my belly and bounced off.
I didn't even shift.
A body this size blocks every path.
Getting this close is asking to die.
One casual shove sends you flying.
Don't rub against me. Filthy.
I shift a foot and you must move.

lines.zh: 撞到我的都是自己倒霉
lines.en: Anyone who bumps me is just unlucky.
The bulk of me is still wobbling.
Two steps back and I won't pursue.
I have no companions, only prey.

lines.zh: 像我这样的东西，不会有伴
lines.en: A thing like me has no partner.

lines.zh: 你要陪我？那得先活下来
lines.en: Keep me company? Survive first.
I'm alone in this nest.
Malice has no need to breed.
Don't mimic me. I dislike it.
I reach out and you'd break.

lines.zh: 一个人守着这片冥土，够了
lines.en: One of me guarding this underworld is enough.
I never share prey.
Stand there and I won't touch you.
I crush that stone in my hand.
I can't be bothered to bend for things on the ground.
One grab, and the soil comes up with it.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进嘴里，没什么味道
lines.en: I stuff it in my mouth; it has no taste.
I pick it up out of mere curiosity.
Too small to grip.
I hold it, then toss it aside.
You want it? Come get it.
I crush it into powder.
My palm is bigger than a door.
I woke because you came.
I've locked onto your ki.
I lift my head, eyes fully open.
This body of mine is heating up.
You're in my nest. You can't escape.
I clench my fists.
Space warps beside my hand.
I'll scatter your ki.
My grin widens.

lines.zh: 从这一刻起，你是我唯一的目标
lines.en: From this moment, you are my only target.
I close the distance, step by step.
I don't shout, and I don't warn.
You stand too straight. Perfect.
My hand is up. Don't blink.

lines.zh: 这个竞技场，只留一个出去
lines.en: Only one leaves this arena.
My shadow lunges first.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，我记住了
lines.en: I've memorized your scent.
Let's begin.
You go left, and I block the left.

lines.zh: 我不用追，我只要压过去
lines.en: I don't chase; I simply press forward.
Your ki flickers. You're afraid.

lines.zh: 我在算你退到墙边的时间
lines.en: I'm counting when you'll reach the wall.

lines.zh: 这拳头会从上面落下来
lines.en: This fist comes down from above.
Space folds inside my grip.

lines.zh: 你躲得过一次，躲不过十次
lines.en: You dodge once, not ten times.
My grin keeps widening.
Your footsteps have lost their rhythm.
The Dimension Fist ignores distance.
I raise my palm and ki gathers there.
Not far now. Three more steps.
I want to hear you scream.
This whole place is in my hands.
There's a wall behind you.
I've been waiting for this.
My breathing has matched yours.
Now. Hold still.
I'll flatten this whole area.
For the last blow, I'll hold back a little.
Demon fist — take it.

lines.zh: 我这一拳，能把石台打穿
lines.en: This punch goes through the stone platform.
Dimension fist; space breaks with it.
Bursting meteor, falling from above.
I roar, and your ears will bleed.
A sphere of destruction forms in my hand.
Three blows; you can't block them all.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸在地上，地面翻起来
lines.en: I smash the ground and it heaves.
You dodged, but the shockwave didn't.
My grin never stopped, and neither did my hands.
My dimensional fist drives you backwards.
I've got you.
You are still gasping. I will wait.
Your bones are creaking.
I open my eyes from a long sleep.

lines.zh: 冥界的石台在我身下震动
lines.en: The stone platform shakes beneath me.

lines.zh: 有人踏进了我的竞技场
lines.en: Someone has entered my arena.

lines.zh: 封印松了，我终于能动了
lines.en: The seal loosened; I can move at last.

lines.zh: 我站起来，头顶快碰到天
lines.en: I rise; my head nearly touches the sky.

lines.zh: 这台子装不下我，但我还是来了
lines.en: This platform can't hold me, yet here I am.

lines.zh: 我的笑声先到，身体才到
lines.en: My laughter arrives before my body does.
Every torch around goes out at once.

lines.zh: 我伸了个懒腰，空间吱吱响
lines.en: I stretch, and space creaks.

lines.zh: 这副模样，是恶意捏出来的
lines.en: This shape was molded from malice.

lines.zh: 我踩下第一脚，石头就碎了
lines.en: My first step shatters the stone.

lines.zh: 你叫醒了我，就得付代价
lines.en: You woke me. Now you pay.

lines.zh: 我肚子上的肉一层叠一层
lines.en: The fat of my belly folds in layers.

lines.zh: 风从我的影子里吹出来
lines.en: Wind blows out of my shadow.

lines.zh: 我看了看自己的手，很满意
lines.en: I look at my hands and am pleased.

lines.zh: 这个世界的空气太干净了
lines.en: The air of this world is too clean.
I'll foul it.

lines.zh: 我的气把周围的虫子都吓跑了
lines.en: My ki drives every insect away.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，第一次看见你
lines.en: I raise my head and see you for the first time.
Begin. Let me stretch my limbs.

lines.zh: 火在我身上烧，我拿它取暖
lines.en: Fire burns on me, and I take it as warmth.

lines.zh: 我从高空砸下来，这具身体也吃不消
lines.en: I crash down from high up, and even this body suffers.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我的气被压住了
lines.en: Water floods in and smothers my ki.

lines.zh: 爆炸撕开了我的一层皮
lines.en: The blast tore a layer off my hide.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我肩膀，很痒
lines.en: Something sticks in my shoulder. It itches.
That sealing magic again.

lines.zh: 太久没吃东西，这身体开始空了
lines.en: Too long without food; this body empties out.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我身上，我又笑了一下
lines.en: Lightning strikes me, and I grin again.

lines.zh: 连我也被虚空拖着往下走
lines.en: Even I am dragged down by the void.
